description: Gate rules for the acceptance ledger (docs/REHEARSAL-ACCEPTANCE-LEDGER.md G0-G9). A gate is PASS only when it names producers and every one succeeded in the candidate run; FAIL when any failed; NOT_RUN otherwise. Producers are CI jobs/checks reported in producers.json by .github/workflows/build-and-test.yml; 'traceability' is computed from the bound obligations. Add a producer here only when CI really produces it.

gates.title: Scope
gates.definition: requirement ids, owner, profile priority, source precedence resolution
gates.note: Praxis requirements preservation verify at acceptance (no released build yet: F-004); produced by the coordinator

gates.title: Dependencies
gates.definition: verified package/SHA/integrity lock, SDK, WASM/Forma/Folio smoke
gates.note: lock-gate is the T11 stack lock gate (PASS needs package-lock.json); stack-smoke is the Limen startup / Forma render / Folio print / frozen golden replay smoke (DEP-CURRENT-004), not yet produced

gates.title: Interfaces
gates.definition: frozen versioned handoff manifest and producer/consumer tests

gates.title: Domain
gates.definition: F# unit tests, illegal-transition and forged-history variants
gates.note: domain-obligations: every G3 requirement bound and passing; not yet produced

gates.title: Frozen data
gates.definition: five golden scenarios, hashes, negative fixtures

gates.title: UI
gates.definition: P0 screen contracts, startup/error, iPad/keyboard/a11y, projection fidelity
gates.note: percepta verify-app against the built site; not yet produced

gates.title: Persistence
gates.definition: local vs remote truth, expected-version conflict, reload, no fixture mutation
gates.note: the live provider suite (CAUSA_GITHUB_TOKEN / CAUSA_TEST_REPO), main pushes only

gates.title: Defect class
gates.definition: independent review and SHA-bound closure for critical/recurring classes

gates.title: Candidate
gates.note: traceability succeeds only when every plan obligation is bound to executed tests that all passed

gates.title: Deployment
gates.definition: deployed SHA equals verified SHA, successful acceptance job on same SHA
gates.note: deploy and deployed-smoke run on main pushes when DEPLOY_TARGET=github-pages
